name: kraksend-operations
title: KrakSend Operations
description: Global email statistics, delivery and attempt inspection, bounce feedback, suppression management and audit history, and campaign recipient visibility.
docs: Mount SendOperationsAdmin behind the host admin guard. Supply the protected SendOperations API data, localized messages, server filters/pagination and authoritative suppression callbacks. See src/agent-examples/send/console.tsx for a unified contacts/campaigns/operations host panel. Removal requires the exact reviewed version and an audit reason; it never restores consent or resends mail. No rendered bodies, signed unsubscribe tokens or credentials are returned by the operations API.
